releaseNotes: Chronos HSC v1.3.2: Linked Chapter Chains (sequential chapters cascade domino shifts & missed day jumps automatically down the study pipeline), dedicated Test Paper Solving (টেস্ট পেপার সমাধান) topic mode, Bidirectional Swipe (swipe right to slash complete, swipe left to restore/undone), and Serious Minimalist Black & White OLED UI theme for Black Lover mode (keeping Nature Lover 100% untouched).
